ไม่ใช่คนที่ทำความชั่วมาโดยตลอด แต่

คือคนที่ทำความดี แล้วเอาความดีนั้น

มาสร้างตัวตนให้ตนเองอีกชั้นหนึ่ง

หน้าตารูปร่างดีกว่า

snippet.title: $US2.5 trillion Nasdaq sell-off spreads across Asia  | The Business | ABC NEWS
snippet.description:
Wall Street's tech sell-off has spread to Asia as investors questioned the US Democrats' approach to data centre investment. 
BetaShares chief economist David Bassanese spoke to The Business' Alicia Barry.
Mr Bassanese said the market reaction to the Democrats' victory in the US midterms election is "perplexing". 
On Wall Street, the pain was extreme, the S&P 500 sank 4.4%. The Nasdaq plunged 5.5% into correction territory and the Dow lost 3.4%. It was Wall Street's worst session since 'Liberation Day' tariffs were announced in April 2025. 
Australia was less exposed given the tiny technology component of the main index. It was miners, exposed to the AI build out trade through copper, that dropped the most. By the close of trade on Friday, the ASX 200 lost 0.5% to 9,021, but for the week it posted a 1.3% gain.

#MGISLonYT || Mohun Bagan Super Giant vs Odisha FC || Match Content || Full Match Replay || Match 25 || 05-Nov-2026 || English || #YTIndia

Mohun Bagan Super Giant beat Odisha FC 3-2 in a second-half thriller at the Salt Lake Stadium, and Lee Erwin’s 87th-minute winner took them back to the top of the MG Indian Super League 2026-27 table!

After a goalless first half, Dejan Dražić put the Mariners ahead two minutes after the restart from Anirudh Thapa’s pass. Five minutes later, Mahmoud Eid levelled for Odisha from Nihal Sudeesh’s ball. Dražić struck again in the 68th minute, set up by Lalrinfela Khiangte, but Everton equalised for Odisha with 11 minutes left. Erwin then won it three minutes from time. Mohun Bagan finished with 28 shots to Odisha’s 16.

Match highlight: It’s a fourth straight win for Mohun Bagan, who now have 12 points from five games. Dražić and Erwin have now scored in back-to-back matches, after both found the net against Punjab last weekend.

Goals: MBSG: Dejan Dražić (47’, 68’), Lee Erwin (87’) | OFC: Mahmoud Eid (52’), Everton (79’)

Mohun Bagan Super Giant beat Odisha FC 3-2 in a second-half thriller at the Salt Lake Stadium, and Lee Erwin’s 87th-minute winner took them back to the top of the MG Indian Super League 2026-27 table!

After a goalless first half, Dejan Dražić put the Mariners ahead two minutes after the restart from Anirudh Thapa’s pass. Five minutes later, Mahmoud Eid levelled for Odisha from Nihal Sudeesh’s ball. Dražić struck again in the 68th minute, set up by Lalrinfela Khiangte, but Everton equalised for Odisha with 11 minutes left. Erwin then won it three minutes from time. Mohun Bagan finished with 28 shots to Odisha’s 16.

Match highlight: It’s a fourth straight win for Mohun Bagan, who now have 12 points from five games. Dražić and Erwin have now scored in back-to-back matches, after both found the net against Punjab last weekend.

Massa pendukung Joko Widodo (Jokowi) berkumpul di Pengadilan Negeri Jakarta Timur, Kamis (5/11/2026).
Salah satu pendukung mengaku datang dari Balaraja, Kabupaten Tangerang, Banten, menggunakan bus.
Kehadiran para pendukung membuat suasana di sekitar PN Jakarta Timur semakin ramai menjelang sidang. Massa dari kedua kubu, baik pendukung Jokowi maupun Roy Suryo, mulai berdatangan sejak pagi.
Untuk mengantisipasi kerumunan, aparat kepolisian memperketat pengamanan dan membatasi jumlah pendukung yang diperbolehkan masuk ke ruang sidang.
Presiden ke-7 RI Jokowi datang ke PN Jakarta Timur sebagai saksi dalam sidang perkara dugaan pencemaran nama baik terkait tudingan ijazah palsu dengan terdakwa Roy Suryo dan Dokter Tifa
